title: Nonstandard likelihood-ratio limits under semidefinite rank constraints
summary: We study likelihood-ratio tests for the hypothesis that a positive-semidefinite matrix has rank at most a prescribed value. The null hypothesis is stratified: points of maximal allowed rank lie on a regular boundary stratum, whereas lower-rank points are singular. Consequently, the usual chi-bar-square calibration on the top stratum does not by itself describe the whole composite null, especially along sequences whose rank changes at the local $n^{-1/2}$ scale.
